articles.title: This Pharma Stock Is Surging 40%. Neurocrine Is Buying It in $2.9 Billion Deal.
articles.mainIdea: This Pharma Stock Is Surging 40%. Neurocrine Is Buying It in $2.9 Billion Deal.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: This Pharma Stock Is Surging 40%. Neurocrine Is Buying It in $2.9 Billion Deal.. Soleno Therapeutics stock surged 40% in premarket trading Monday after Neurocrine Biosciences announced it had agreed to buy the company in a deal worth $2.9 billion. Neurocrine Biosciences said that it had agreed to buy Soleno—the maker of a drug to treat extreme hunger—for $53 per share in cash, representing a total deal value of $2.9 billion. Shares in Soleno jumped 40% in the Monday premarket to $54.95 after the stock closed Thursday at $39.49. Related tickers mentioned: NBIX, SLNO.

Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) has received U.S. FDA approval for Foundayo, the first once daily oral GLP 1 pill for obesity, and has begun rapid U.S. commercialization. The company has reached a major U.S. government pricing and access agreement that broadens GLP 1 availability for Medicare and Medicaid patients.
